articles.title: IBM (IBM) Beats Q1 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
articles.mainIdea: IBM (IBM) Beats Q1 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
articles.summary: Zacks: IBM (IBM) Beats Q1 Earnings and Revenue Estimates. IBM (IBM) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +5.33% and +1.49%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

articles.title: IBM Stock Slides Late Despite Earnings Beating Expectations
articles.mainIdea: IBM Stock Slides Late Despite Earnings Beating Expectations
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: IBM Stock Slides Late Despite Earnings Beating Expectations. IBM posted adjusted earnings and revenue growth ahead of expectations for its March quarter. Meanwhile, IBM reiterated its previous forecast for 2026 full-year constant currency revenue growth of more than 5%. IBM's software segment sales grew 11% to $7.1 billion, ahead of forecasts for 10.3% growth, according to FactSet.

articles.title: IBM Posts Higher Sales, Buoyed by AI
articles.mainIdea: IBM Posts Higher Sales, Buoyed by AI
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: IBM Posts Higher Sales, Buoyed by AI. “AI continues to be a tailwind for our business,” IBM Chief Financial Officer Jim Kavanaugh said in an interview. “You see it play out in the results, as we captured demand for both technology and innovation around AI, but also services that help organizations orchestrate, deploy, govern, scale AI.” The technology company on Wednesday reported a first-quarter profit of $1.22 billion, or $1.28 a share, compared with a profit of $1.06 billion, or $1.14 a share, a year earlier.
